comparison.objective: Sort sequential colored blocks from a moving conveyor into bins; candidate tunes and mechanically locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed bimanual pick-and-place versus tool alignment, screw release/locking, fine collar adjustment, and dynamic-response diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly placed stationary blocks with no belt-end accumulation versus two safe repeatable carriage stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Conveyor sorting does not test adjustment, locking, or energy-absorption commissioning.
